reason: VALUE/TRANSFER lens: refuted. Expected public gain is about 0 (-0.001..+0.001), well below +0.002, and no probe could tell it apart from the 0.003 LB noise. (1) The evidence is miscited. The '+0.046 on unseen embryos' (CONTEXT.md l.355) is the public pipeline against our clean pipeline, four heuristics together; the dual-seed share was never isolated. The primary candidate is not independent: leonixis/biohub-v5-candidates is 'all-train 199 videos, 60 epochs, WARM START from v3res; LB checkpoint-pick set' (research/browser_research_2026-09-24_pass2.md l.77). It is a fine-tune of a pilkwang-lineage model, with its epoch chosen on public LB, and it scored 0.947 = the wall. (2) The LB prior is 4/4 negative. Every detector-blend change we probed lost: secondary weight 0.8->0.5 -0.002, secondary:=exp08 -0.016, secondary:=exp23 (fine-tuned seed314159) -0.007, secondary:=friend A scratch -0.025 (experiments/RESULTS.md l.37,39,42,46). Pilkwang-init fine-tunes add no diversity (RESULTS l.39), and x138's threshold 0.965 and tail are calibrated to the 0.2/0.8 blend. andnyu's public 'synthetic-conditional-third-model' scored 0.946, below the wall (pass2 l.54-55). (3) Ceiling from the metric. With lab T = 135,729 edges, one FN->TP is worth +7.4e-6 J. Recovering 2/5/10% of the never-detected (~2,090) plus swap (~2,700) FN gives +0.0007/+0.0018/+0.0035. The 10% the idea assumes is not credible, for three reasons. (a) Never-detected: the blend is on per-frame mean/std-aligned LOGITS (x138 cell 4 patch 2), so replacing 0.2 of S by T moves a pixel by 0.2(T-S). A node missed by both P and S comes back only if T beats S by 5x the gap to the threshold. The near-threshold cases are already rescued by x138's READMIT and gap filler on sub-threshold peaks (LOWDET 0.3). The 44b6 misses are under-segmentation, which a same-grid (1,4,4) model does not fix, and averaging offset peaks broadens blobs and merges more. (b) Swap/position: going from weights 0.2/0.8 to 0.2/0.6/0.2 cuts peak-jitter sd by only 2-4% for correlated models (rho 0.7-0.85; 7% even at rho 0.5). The GT offset is mostly bias (embryo z offset 44b6 +0.18 um, 6bba +0.82 um) and structure, not jitter. The V1284 head analogy (~10% offset cut = +0.007 on x138) then gives +0.0005..+0.0015 gross, and the head already refines positions on the primary features. (c) Node multiplier: any gain from averaging away spurious peaks is the -1.7% node effect (worth ~+0.0015 through the multiplier) that the 0.90 retention guard partly reverses, and its sign on an unseen embryo is unknown. Gross ceiling ~+0.001..+0.003, minus a calibration cost that was at least -0.002 in every past blend change, so net E ~0. (4) Transfer. No honest local check exists: every candidate model saw all 199 videos, so the lab is in-sample and 44b6 is one recording. Public is one embryo, and noise ~0.003 (identical notebooks 0.946/0.942). A +0.003 adoption gate on a null change passes by luck ~15% of the time (guess, sd ~0.0025), and a pass selected that way is winner's-curse biased on private. The private argument ('more diverse = more robust OOD') is weakened by the warm start and by the unknown node-count shift on new embryos. (5) Cost: +4 forward passes per window (+~25% detection GPU) on a kernel already near the 7.5 h degrade line, so it depends on a budget guard whose own value verdict was refuted as standalone (v_ensembles-and-private_x138-budget-aware-deadline_value.json).
fix_if_any: Only a changed mechanism could survive, and only as a finals candidate, never a sweep. (1) Do NOT blend logits: that shifts the calibrated heatmap every frame. Keep P/S detection byte-identical, and use T only as an extra VOTER for the existing READMIT/gap-filler pool: admit a sub-threshold P/S peak only if T also has a peak >= 0.965 within 3 um. This keeps node count within ~0.5% (gate on the dummy run: nodes +-0.5% of exp56, sha-identical when T is disabled). (2) Use a model that is truly independent AND different: not warm-started from pilkwang weights, a different recipe (e.g. georgexue666 pool-2 sigma-0.8, easonyanyan team 0.950). It can only vote if its peaks are resampled to the (1,4,4) grid, since it cannot be averaged in. Browser check of the licence and config first. (3) Run it only if the user has a spare slot on 27-28 Sep after the higher-value ideas, and adopt it as F1 only if public >= F1 + 0.004. Otherwise it may only be F2, and only if its node count differs by < 1%. Expected gain even repaired: ~+0.001 (guess), so this is not recommended.
realistic_public_gain: ~0 (range -0.003..+0.002; mean ~-0.0005). Gross ceiling from metric arithmetic +0.001..+0.003; the historical cost of every detector-blend perturbation (-0.002..-0.025, 4/4 negative) offsets it. Not measurable against LB noise 0.003.
realistic_private_gain: ~0 +- 0.003 (guess). The OOD-diversity argument is weak because the leonixis model is warm-started and LB-epoch-picked; the node-count shift on unseen embryos has unknown sign; and public-gated adoption adds winner's-curse bias.
